INTRO_LINE.text: Hello! Today we learn about living and non-living things around us.

SCENE_01_TEXT.text: Welcome, explorers! Today we learn living and non-living things.

SCENE_02_TEXT.text: By the end, you can sort things into two groups.

SCENE_03_TEXT.text: Living things are alive. They move, breathe, and grow.

SCENE_04_TEXT.text: Living things need air to breathe. Animals and plants both breathe.

SCENE_05_TEXT.text: Living things need food and water. Food gives energy to work and play.

SCENE_06_TEXT.text: Living things grow. A seed becomes a plant, and a puppy becomes a dog.

SCENE_07_TEXT.text: Living things can feel. We feel heat, cold, touch, and pain.

SCENE_08_TEXT.text: Non-living things are not alive. They do not breathe, eat, or grow.

SCENE_09_TEXT.text: Natural non-living things include rocks, water, soil, sand, air, and sunlight.

SCENE_10_TEXT.text: Man-made non-living things are made by people, like clothes, toys, and desks.

SCENE_11_TEXT.text: Cars and buses help us move. Phones and computers use electricity.

SCENE_12_TEXT.text: Great review! Living things breathe, eat, grow, and feel. Non-living things do not.
